title: Generate SQL Script from Model
description: Learn to generate SQL scripts from EF Core migrations for deployment.

data.text: Generate SQL scripts from migrations for manual execution or source control. This is recommended for production deployments.

data.title: Generate Script Examples
data.code:
# Generate script for all migrations
dotnet ef migrations script

# Generate from specific migration
dotnet ef migrations script InitialSchoolDB

# Generate between migrations
dotnet ef migrations script InitialSchoolDB LatestMigration

# Generate idempotent script
dotnet ef migrations script --idempotent

data.title: Idempotent Scripts
data.text: Idempotent scripts check which migrations have already been applied and only apply missing ones. Useful for production deployments.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Generate SQL scripts for production deployment
Can generate for all or specific migrations
data.takeaway: Continue to learn about advanced features.
